structural_gap_note: AFC squads play mainly J-League / K-League / Saudi Pro League / Qatar Stars League, which have no public pre-2022 shot-level xG on any source (Understat or FBref), so finishing inputs cannot be assembled leakage-clean for most AFC players regardless of scraping effort. FBref could lift CONMEBOL/CAF/CONCACAF (MLS, Liga MX, Brazil Serie A, Eredivisie, Primeira) but not AFC.
match_caveat: Understat carries no nationality; players matched to the roster by unique normalized name only. Ambiguous names were dropped (see understat_ambiguous_names_dropped).
